data.description:
## Context / Problem

ADR 0122 is the binding design record for similar-ticket retrieval. Three of its statements become wrong once the sibling index story lands a lexical tier that needs no model provider, and one requirement of the epic is unmet by the ADR as written.

## Approach

### The tiering decision is absent

ADR 0122 compared candidates and adopted `vector`, but it records no decision about what runs when no model provider is configured. The architecture the stories actually build is two-tiered: a lexical FTS5 default available in every installation, and an opt-in embedding upgrade over the same index. An ADR that does not record that split leaves the default undocumented and leaves a future reader unable to tell whether the lexical path is a fallback, a deliberate tier, or dead code.

### The deployment precondition is too broad

ADR 0122's "Deployment precondition" section (`docs/adr/0122-similar-ticket-retrieval.md:180-194`) states the index cannot "be built anywhere but a developer's own credentials". That was true when the only candidate was embedding-backed. It is false for the lexical tier, which needs no credentials at all. Left as written, it tells operators the feature is unavailable to them when it is not.

The precondition is narrowed so it constrains the embedding tier rather than the index as a whole.

### No latency figure is recorded

ADR 0122 reports recall, significance and cost, but no latency figure anywhere. The parent epic requires the ADR to report the cold-catch-up p95. The sibling index story emits that measurement; this story records it.

### IAM citations have drifted

ADR 0122's IAM line citations point at `:15-18`; the live file has the relevant lines at `:16-17`. A reader following the citation lands on the wrong lines.

### Scope

Documentation only. No source change, no configuration change, no new mechanism.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docs/adr/0122-similar-ticket-retrieval.md` records the two-tier decision, naming the lexical tier as the default that requires no model provider and the embedding tier as opt-in. Checked by: the ADR containing it.
- [ ] The ADR's deployment precondition constrains the embedding tier rather than the index as a whole. Checked by: the ADR no longer asserting the index requires a developer's own credentials.
- [ ] The ADR reports the cold-catch-up p95 as a numeric figure, taken from the sibling index story's measurement. Checked by: the ADR containing the figure.
- [ ] The ADR's IAM line citations resolve to the lines they describe in `infra/terraform/iam_s7.tf`. Checked by: reading the cited lines.
- [ ] No file outside `docs/` is modified. Checked by: the change's diff touching only `docs/`.
data.title: Amend ADR 0122 for the two-tier retrieval decision and measured p95
